critical_code_review_comments: ValueProps.jsx cleanly composed: each card uses a self-contained CARDS config (title/body/image/blob/tilt/sticker) and a small BlobShape SVG component - easy to extend to 4+ cards without rewrites.

Hero illustration uses CSS filter brightness(0) invert(1) to force white on the dark bg - works for solid PNG illustrations served from static.prod-images.emergentagent.com; if any future illustration relies on color, this filter must be removed per-card.
All unsplash background images use inline-style backgroundImage which means they bypass tailwind's content scanning - intentional and correct here.
Menu overlay correctly uses an en-dash in 'Mon–Sat' per spec; the strict 'no em dash' rule is satisfied (em-dash count = 0).
data-testid coverage remains 100% on every interactive element listed in the regression set.
